candidates.description: These tokens represent common German noun and verb prefixes or root morphemes, particularly starting with the letters "ge" or "Ge".
This vector represents frequent German grammatical function words, including auxiliary verbs, conjunctions, and pronouns.
This vector represents German pronominal adverbs and words starting with the prefix "dar-".
These tokens represent common German present-tense action and linking verbs.
This vector is related to German words, morphemes, and characters containing the letter 'ß'.
These tokens function as German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs indicating necessity, possibility, or tense.
These tokens represent common German discourse markers and connecting adverbs used to modulate emphasis, concession, or logical flow in a sentence.
This vector activates on German demonstrative and determinative pronouns and articles along with grammatically and morphologically similar terms.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'ä' and words containing it across various European languages.
